description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, installation of front wall and new gate and detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (423_PL_102 [received 23/12/2019] and 423_PL_000, 423_PL_105 (A), 423_PL_001, 423_PL_101, 423_PL_102, 423_PL_103, 423_PL_104, 423_PL_201, 423_PL_202, 423_PL_203, 423_PL_204, 423_PL_301, Arboricultural Impact Assessment Plan, Arboricultural and Planning Integration Report, Flood Risk Assessment document and Design and Access Statement [received 19/11/2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used incidental to the use of 56 Barrowgate Road, W4 4QU, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be as shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
